summary: R1-R5 and every ruling are delivered by P1-P4, and each acceptance criterion has implementing work I can point at in the tree: V01-V03 in charts/homelab-shared/templates (the hook Job matches design.md:331-357 field for field), V04/V15/V19 in the HelmCharts diff (additive only, symlink at mode 120000, no dependencies:), V05-V08 in package-chart.sh/build-index.sh/Dockerfile/nginx/default.conf/Jenkinsfile (both :<build> and :latest, kaniko2's defaults cover the omitted dockerfile/context), V09/V10/V12/V13 in configs/prd/charts/, V16 in the library values, V17 in .kubecoder/project.yaml. The rest — V06, V11, V14 and the live half of V12/V13 — are live-endpoint checks the test phase owns, and V18 holds now (HelmCharts is ahead 1, unpushed). No done-record admits an unaddressed leftover: P4's one recorded exception (the TF-owned rbd refute cannot be forced to bite, because the mutation errors the render first) is explained and the regression is still caught as a red render. Nothing depends on something no phase produced, and there is no mechanical residue — git diff --check is clean in both repos, all four scripts pass bash -n and build-index.sh passes dash -n — so I made no edits and nothing needed committing. Two operator-sequencing findings from this pass are carded rather than appended: they need no code, but the second one changes the order of the keystrokes P2's done-record records.
cards: HelmCharts: origin/main moved two commits past the slice base while the run was executing (e87150d, touching charts/nginx/files/snippets/proxy.conf and scripts/setup-env.sh). The P3 commit 053ddab is 'ahead 1, behind 2', so the operator's push is rejected as non-fast-forward until `git pull --rebase`. No conflict — P3 only adds new paths under charts/charts/ and configs/prd/charts/.

Charts: the recorded order 'create IaC/Charts and run it once BEFORE the test phase pushes Charts' is not executable. pvginkel/Charts exists on GitHub but is empty (git ls-remote returns zero refs), so a Pipeline-from-SCM build has no main to check out, fails before any Groovy runs, and properties() never registers githubPush(). Workable order: create the job -> test phase pushes -> operator manually runs IaC/Charts once (this is the build that produces the image V11 needs) -> pushes thereafter auto-trigger.

Charts: containerTemplates.helm (alpine/helm:3.9.1, run as a sleep-infinity sidecar) has no other user across the checked-out estate — IaC/Charts' first build is the first exercise of that container template, not just of the Helm 3-vs-4 indexing gap P2 recorded. If it misbehaves the fallback is one line: containerTemplates.modern_app_dev, which carries Helm 4.
